W.note: Dark glow field with staggered overshoot assembly, burst and reassembly loops cleanly on 5 s, but it rebuilds Figma's own five-shape mark, which breaks the no-logo rule.

X.note: Flat primitives with stripes and a starburst feel brand-adjacent, but the starburst rotates 90 degrees and snaps back at the seam (its shape is not 90-degree symmetric), and a letterbox band shows at the bottom of the desktop frame.

Y.note: A bounded card of brand-palette primitives with Figma-style transform handles; every CSS keyframe returns to its start value, the motion is gentle, and it avoids copying the logo.

Z.note: Reproduces Figma's five-shape mark almost exactly on a flat gray field; the loop is clean, but this is a logo animation rather than a brand visual.
